products.name: Pop It Fidget Toy Set
products.description: 60pcs assorted shapes. Stress relief for kids & adults. TikTok viral.
products.seoDescription: Discover the ultimate pop it fidget toy set for kids and adults, packed with 60 assorted shapes that have taken TikTok by storm. This bulk fidget toy assortment includes circles, squares, hearts, unicorns, and other trending silhouettes — each one designed to deliver that satisfying pop sensation that keeps fingers busy and minds relaxed. Whether you're sourcing impulse-buy novelties for retail shelves, building a classroom reward box, or stocking a party favor catalog, this set delivers unbeatable variety at a price point that protects your margins. Every piece is molded from food-grade silicone that's odorless, washable, and built to withstand thousands of pops without losing its snap-back elasticity. The toys carry both CE and ASTM F963 certifications, giving wholesale buyers confidence that the product meets stringent safety standards in North America, Europe, and beyond. Manufactured in Shantou Chenghai — China's toy capital with decades of export expertise — this set benefits from mature supply-chain infrastructure, meaning consistent quality and reliable lead times even on large OEM orders. Each shape is pocket-sized (3-6 in.), making it ideal for checkout-counter displays, subscription box inserts, and e-commerce bundle offers. Target markets include the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Australia, and the Middle East, where fidget and stress-relief toys continue to chart strong search volumes. Custom packaging, private-label printing, and assorted-shape configurations are available on MOQ.

products.name: STEM Building Blocks 500pc
products.description: Compatible with major brands. Creative gears & wheels. Ages 6+.
products.seoDescription: Elevate your educational toy catalog with this STEM building blocks 500-piece set, engineered for children ages 6 and up who love hands-on construction and creative problem-solving. Fully compatible with all major interlocking brick brands, this kit expands existing collections seamlessly — no awkward fits, no wasted pieces. Beyond standard bricks, the set includes gears, wheels, axles, and connector pieces that let young engineers build working mechanisms: spinning windmills, rolling vehicles, and kinetic sculptures that actually move. It's a STEM learning toy that teaches cause-and-effect, spatial reasoning, and basic mechanical principles without feeling like schoolwork. Certified CE and CPC, the blocks are made from ABS plastic with smooth edges, consistent clutch power, and zero phthalates — meeting the safety benchmarks demanded by distributors in the US, EU, and Australia. Shantou Goworld, the manufacturer, operates an ISO-audited facility with in-house testing labs, so every production run ships with full compliance documentation. The 500-piece count strikes the right balance for retail: substantial enough to feel premium, compact enough for shelf-friendly packaging. Ideal markets include educational suppliers, museum gift shops, e-learning platforms, and toy retailers seeking a high-value STEM construction set that undercuts name-brand pricing without sacrificing quality. OEM color schemes, custom instruction booklets, and branded packaging are available at scale.

products.name: RC Stunt Car 360° Flip
products.description: 2.4GHz, LED lights, all-terrain. 45min play. Best seller age 8-12.
products.seoDescription: Meet the remote control stunt car that does it all — 360-degree flips, all-terrain domination, and eye-catching LED light shows that make every run a spectacle. Powered by a responsive 2.4GHz transmitter, this RC stunt vehicle eliminates signal interference so multiple cars can race simultaneously without crossover issues. The dual-sided body design means there is no right side up — land on the roof and keep driving. Oversized rubber tires grip grass, gravel, carpet, and pavement with equal confidence, while the rechargeable battery delivers up to 45 minutes of continuous play per charge. FCC and CE certified, the car meets electromagnetic and toy-safety requirements for the US, European, and Australian markets. Shantou Aosheng, the manufacturer, is a veteran RC toy exporter with a dedicated QC team that inspects every batch before shipment. The compact form factor (approximately 25 cm) is perfect for ages 8 and up, and the striking LED underglow makes it a guaranteed eye-catcher on retail shelves and in unboxing videos. Wholesale buyers appreciate the low defect rate, consistent performance, and the ability to order custom frequencies and colorways. Whether you are building an RC toy collection for an e-commerce storefront or supplying brick-and-mortar hobby shops, this stunt car offers a proven best-seller with strong repeat-order rates.

products.name: Squishmallow Style Plush 12in
products.description: Ultra-soft short plush. 20+ animal designs. TikTok collection trend.
products.seoDescription: Soft, huggable, and impossible to put down — this 12-inch squishmallow-style plush toy line has become a TikTok sensation and a must-have collectible for kids, teens, and adults alike. Crafted from ultra-soft short-pile plush with a marshmallow-like polyester fill, each character delivers that signature squish that fans cannot stop squeezing. With over 20 unique designs — from sleepy animals to fantasy creatures — the collection encourages repeat purchases and trading, driving higher average order values for retailers. Every plush is EN71 and ASTM F963 certified, ensuring compliance with toy-safety regulations in Europe and North America. The manufacturer, Shantou Miaoji, specializes in character plush and operates a vertically integrated facility covering knitting, stuffing, sewing, and QC under one roof — giving buyers full traceability and consistent quality across production runs. The 12-inch size hits the sweet spot for impulse-buy pricing, gift-basket inclusion, and claw-machine restocking. Key markets include the United States, Canada, UK, Japan, and Australia, where plush collectible trends continue to show strong year-over-year growth in search volume. Custom character designs, private-label tags, and exclusive colorways are available for qualified wholesale orders.

products.name: Magnetic Tiles 100pc Set
products.description: Strong magnets, 3D building. STEM Montessori certified. Ages 3+.
products.seoDescription: Unlock creativity and STEM learning with this magnetic tiles 100-piece building set, designed for children ages 3 and up who love constructing 3D structures that sparkle under the light. Each tile features powerful internal magnets with a secure riveted casing — no loose magnets, no pinch points — meeting the rigorous CE and CPC safety standards required by retailers in the US, EU, and Australia. The set includes a balanced mix of squares, triangles, and specialty shapes that let kids build everything from castles and rockets to geometric sculptures. The translucent, high-clarity plastic catches and refracts light, adding a visual wow factor that makes this set a standout on retail shelves and in social media content. Shantou MagWorld, the manufacturer, uses ultrasonic welding and automated magnet placement to ensure consistent quality at scale, with defect rates well below industry average. The 100-piece count is the industry proven sweet spot: enough variety for satisfying builds, compact enough for attractive packaging. Ideal distribution channels include toy stores, online STEM education retailers, Montessori supply catalogs, and gift shops. OEM packaging, custom tile counts (60/120/200), and exclusive shape additions are available for volume orders.

products.name: Anime Figure Blind Box
products.description: 6 designs + 1 secret. Japanese anime style. Collection craze.
products.seoDescription: Tap into the booming anime collectibles market with this Japanese-style anime figure blind box series — six standard designs plus one ultra-rare secret chase figure that drives collector excitement and repeat purchases. Each box contains one randomly selected PVC figure standing approximately 8 cm tall, hand-painted with meticulous detail that appeals to serious collectors and casual fans alike. The blind-box format is a proven engagement engine: unboxing videos generate organic social media content, while the secret-chase mechanic boosts sell-through rates and creates trading communities around your product. CE certified and manufactured by Shantou Anime Culture — a studio specializing in anime-licensed merchandise with experience supplying Southeast Asian and Latin American distributors — these figures meet toy-safety standards for the European market. The compact packaging is ideal for retail countertop displays, vending machines, and online subscription-box curation. Target demographics include teens and young adults aged 14-30 in the US, Japan, South Korea, Mexico, and Brazil, where anime fandom continues to drive explosive growth in merchandise spending. Custom character licensing, exclusive regional variants, and branded display stands are available for qualified partners.

products.name: Water Beads Sensory Kit
products.description: 50k beads + tools. Fine motor skills. Pre-school sensory play.
products.seoDescription: Fuel sensory play and early childhood development with this water beads sensory kit, featuring over 50,000 non-toxic polymer beads plus a complete set of fine-motor tools — scoopers, tweezers, sorting cups, and a storage tray. Designed for preschool and kindergarten environments, water beads are one of the fastest-growing categories in educational sensory toys, prized by occupational therapists and Montessori educators for their ability to develop hand-eye coordination, finger strength, and color recognition through open-ended play. The beads expand to approximately 12 mm when hydrated and shrink back for compact storage, making them a practical choice for both classroom and home use. CE and CPC certified, the beads are made from sodium polyacrylate — the same material used in baby diapers — ensuring they are non-toxic and biodegradable. Shantou Oubo, the manufacturer, is a sensory-toy specialist with a clean production record and experience exporting to North American and European educational-supply distributors. The kit format with premium packaging and included accessories differentiates it from bulk-bead commodity listings, supporting higher retail pricing and better margin preservation. Key markets include the US, UK, Germany, and Australia, where sensory-play search volumes have doubled year-over-year.

products.name: LED Slime Making Kit
products.description: Glow in dark. Non-toxic PVA. 6 colors + storage box. Age 6+.
products.seoDescription: Light up playtime with this LED slime making kit that glows in the dark — six vibrant colors of non-toxic PVA-based slime, complete with storage containers, mixing tools, and glow-in-the-dark powder that transforms every batch into a luminescent masterpiece. Slime continues to rank among the top-selling DIY toy categories on Amazon and TikTok, and this kit adds the glow-in-the-dark twist that stands out in search results and unboxing videos. Every component is CE and ASTM F963 certified, meeting toy-safety requirements for North American and European markets. The PVA formula is borax-free and non-sticky, addressing the two most common parent complaints about slime products. Shantou Chenghai-based manufacturing ensures competitive pricing, reliable lead times, and access to China's deepest toy supply chain. The kit format — pre-portioned ingredients plus tools — eliminates the mess and guesswork that frustrate home-made slime attempts, making it a parent-friendly gift choice. Each color comes in its own sealed container, extending shelf life and enabling partial-use play sessions. Ideal retail channels include toy stores, craft supply shops, online STEM and DIY toy retailers, and holiday gift guides. Custom color palettes, branded packaging, and bulk event-pack configurations are available for volume orders.

products.name: Mini Excavator 1.8T Diesel
products.description: 1.8 ton, Kubota engine, 2.5m digging depth. 40HQ fits 6 units. CE certified.
products.seoDescription: Power through tight-access excavation jobs with this 1.8-ton mini excavator powered by a proven Kubota diesel engine — the gold standard in compact construction equipment reliability. With a 2.5-meter maximum digging depth and 3.8-meter dumping height, this machine handles trenching, foundation prep, landscaping, and utility work in spaces where full-size excavators simply cannot operate. The compact dimensions allow six units per 40HQ container, dramatically reducing per-unit shipping costs for importers. CE and ISO 9001 certified, the excavator meets European machinery directives and global quality-management standards, opening doors to government tenders and regulated markets. Key features include pilot-operated hydraulic controls for smooth, precise operation; a retractable undercarriage that narrows from 1,500 mm to 1,000 mm for passage through gates and doorways; and a reinforced boom designed for heavy-duty digging cycles. Jining's construction-equipment cluster provides unmatched aftermarket support: spare parts ship within 48 hours, and the standard Kubota engine means filters and service items are available worldwide. Target markets include Australia's booming residential-construction sector, the EU's urban-renovation market, and North American landscaping contractors seeking a cost-competitive alternative to Japanese and Korean brands. OEM branding, custom paint, and ROPS/FOPS cab options are available.

products.name: Road Roller 3T Single Drum
products.description: 3 ton, hydraulic drive, 0.8m drum width. Compaction force 3.2T. Site ready.
products.seoDescription: Compact, powerful, and purpose-built for small-site compaction — this 3-ton single-drum road roller with hydraulic drive delivers professional-grade results on bike paths, driveways, parking lots, and pipeline trench backfill. The 0.8-meter drum width strikes the optimal balance between coverage and maneuverability, while the 3.2-ton centrifugal force ensures deep-density compaction in fewer passes — saving fuel, time, and operator hours on every job. Hydraulic propulsion provides smooth, stepless speed control from 0-8 km/h, with instant forward and reverse for efficient turnarounds in confined spaces. CE certified and manufactured in Jining — one of China's largest construction-machinery hubs — this roller benefits from a mature supply chain that keeps component costs low and spare-parts availability high. The operator platform features vibration-dampened controls, an adjustable seat, and 360-degree visibility, meeting ergonomic and safety requirements for European and Australian job sites. At just 3 tons operating weight, the machine can be transported on a standard flatbed trailer without oversized-load permits, reducing mobilization costs. Key markets include municipal public-works departments, landscaping contractors, and rental-fleet operators seeking a reliable compaction solution at a fraction of the price of European brands. OEM options, ROPS canopy, and diesel/LPG engine variants are available.

products.name: Concrete Mixer 350L Diesel
products.description: 350L drum, 14HP diesel engine. 4 wheels, 180° discharge. Construction ready.
products.seoDescription: Mix, pour, and move — this 350-liter diesel concrete mixer is the workhorse that small contractors and rural builders reach for when reliable on-site mixing matters most. Powered by a robust 14 HP diesel engine, it delivers consistent batch quality even in off-grid locations where electricity is unavailable. The four-wheel configuration allows a single operator to reposition the mixer across the job site by hand, while the 180-degree swivel discharge chute enables precise pouring into wheelbarrows, forms, or directly into place. The drum features reinforced steel interior and abrasion-resistant paddles for uniform mixing and long service life, even with abrasive aggregates. CE certified and manufactured by Jining Shengbang — a specialist in small-scale construction equipment with over a decade of export experience — this mixer ships with full compliance documentation for EU and Australian customs clearance. At 350 liters, the drum capacity hits the sweet spot for residential foundations, fence-post footings, and small commercial slabs — large enough for productivity, small enough for easy loading by hand or mini skid-steer. Target markets include sub-Saharan Africa, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and rural Australia, where diesel-powered equipment is preferred for reliability and fuel availability. OEM branding, electric-start upgrade, and custom drum capacities are available.

products.name: Mini Crane 5T Truck-Mounted
products.description: 5 ton, 12m boom, 360° rotation. Mounts on pickup. Remote control included.
products.seoDescription: Lift, reach, and place with precision using this 5-ton truck-mounted mini crane featuring a 12-meter telescopic boom and full 360-degree rotation — mounted directly on a standard pickup chassis for maximum jobsite mobility. This is the crane that small contractors, tree-service companies, and solar-installation crews have been waiting for: serious lifting capacity without the cost and logistics burden of a dedicated crane truck. The remote-control system allows the operator to position loads while maintaining line-of-sight from the ground, improving safety and reducing the need for a second person to direct the lift. CE and ISO 9001 certified, the crane meets European machinery safety directives and is backed by Jining Hengfa's established export-quality management system. The boom extends from 4 to 12 meters in four sections, with a maximum lift capacity of 5 tons at short radius — enough for steel beams, prefabricated panels, HVAC units, and construction materials. Hydraulic outriggers provide stable support on uneven terrain. At under 9 meters overall length when mounted, the crane-pickup combo can navigate urban streets and access restricted sites where full-size cranes cannot operate. Key markets include North American general contractors, Australian mining-support services, and European modular-construction firms. Custom boom lengths, load-moment indicators, and OEM paint schemes are available.

products.name: Skid Steer Loader 0.8T
products.description: 0.8 ton, auxiliary hydraulics, rubber tracks. 8 attachments optional. Compact job sites.
products.seoDescription: Versatility defines this 0.8-ton skid steer loader — auxiliary hydraulics power up to eight different attachments, from buckets and pallet forks to trenchers and sweepers, making it the Swiss-army knife of compact construction equipment. Rubber tracks provide sure-footed traction on soft ground, finished surfaces, and steep slopes without the damage that wheeled machines can cause, while the compact footprint (under 1.5 m wide) allows access through standard gate openings and interior doorways. CE and EPA certified, the loader meets both European machinery-safety standards and US emissions regulations — a dual qualification that opens the widest possible market for importers. Jining Haohong, the manufacturer, offers a comprehensive attachment line that can be bundled with the base machine, creating attractive package deals for distributors. The pilot-operated joystick controls are intuitive for operators transitioning from larger skid steers, reducing training time and boosting productivity from day one. Key markets include Australian and New Zealand dairy farms (for barn cleaning and feed handling), North American landscaping contractors, and European municipal maintenance fleets. The 0.8-ton class is the fastest-growing segment in compact equipment, driven by urban-construction demand and rental-fleet expansion. OEM branding, steel-track options, and custom attachment packages are available.

products.name: Diecast Excavator Model 1:50
products.description: Zinc alloy, 1:50 scale. Movable tracks & boom. Collector gift box. Age 14+.

This is not a toy; it is a collector-grade replica designed for display cases, executive desks, and construction-industry gift shops. The weight in the hand is satisfying and authentic — zinc alloy construction ensures durability and a premium feel that plastic models simply cannot match. The tracks roll, the boom swings 360 degrees, and the bucket curls and dumps, allowing collectors to pose the model in realistic working positions. Each unit ships in a collector gift box with a clear window, foam insert, and specification card — presentation that justifies premium retail pricing. products.name: Power Trowel 36in Concrete Finishing
products.description: 36in blade, Honda GX160 engine. Finishing & floating. Construction essential.
products.seoDescription: Finish concrete like a professional with this 36-inch power trowel powered by the legendary Honda GX160 engine — the industry benchmark for reliability, easy starting, and fuel efficiency. This machine handles both floating and finishing passes, allowing a single operator to achieve a smooth, flat slab surface on residential floors, warehouse floors, and commercial flatwork in a fraction of the time required by hand finishing. The 36-inch diameter is the sweet spot for small-to-medium pours: wide enough for productive coverage, compact enough to fit through doorways and into tight corners. Adjustable pitch control lets the operator dial in the perfect blade angle — flat for floating, angled for finishing — while the ergonomically positioned handle reduces fatigue during extended operation. CE certified and manufactured in Jining — China's construction-equipment hub — this power trowel ships with full EU compliance documentation. The Honda GX160 powerplant ensures worldwide parts availability and technician familiarity, eliminating the support headaches common with proprietary engines. Key markets include Australian concrete contractors, Middle Eastern developers, and Latin American construction firms seeking professional-grade finishing equipment at competitive pricing. OEM branding, 46-inch upgrade, and rotor-style conversion kits are available for volume orders.

products.name: Mini Dumper 500kg Tracked
products.description: 500kg capacity, rubber tracks, 7HP gasoline. 25° climbing. Garden & construction.
products.seoDescription: Go anywhere, haul anything — this 500 kg tracked mini dumper is the compact hauling solution for construction sites, gardens, farms, and any terrain that defeats wheeled carts. Rubber tracks distribute weight across a wide footprint, enabling the machine to traverse mud, sand, gravel, and slopes up to 25 degrees — terrain that would bog down a wheeled alternative. Powered by a reliable 7 HP gasoline engine, the dumper features a hydraulic dump bed that raises and lowers with a single lever, allowing one person to load, transport, and dump material without manual lifting. The 500 kg payload handles sand, gravel, soil, debris, and construction materials in a single trip, dramatically reducing cycle times on any job. CE and EPA certified, the dumper meets European machinery-safety standards and US emissions regulations, qualifying it for import into the world's most demanding markets. Jining Tengyu, the manufacturer, backs the machine with a one-year warranty and 48-hour spare-parts shipping. The compact dimensions (under 2 m long, under 0.9 m wide) allow the dumper to pass through gateways, narrow alleys, and building interiors. Key markets include Japanese and Korean landscape-maintenance firms, Australian hobby farmers, and European vineyard operators who need low-impact hauling on sensitive ground. OEM options include diesel engines, extended beds, and custom track widths.
